inputs.model.prompt: A 5-second, 16:9 cinematic shot, photorealistic, golden hour cinematography. A vast empty palace hall, floor of worn dark wood, one enormous window pouring a single wide shaft of amber light across the center, dust drifting inside it. A barefoot dancer in a pale ivory dress steps into the beam and performs one slow full turn, her dress and long hair fanning out through the golden dust, then stills mid-pose as the light catches her face. Camera: slow push-in from a wide shot to a medium view. Look: amber, ivory, and deep shadow only, film grain. Audio: empty hall reverb, a soft fabric swirl, her calm breath, a single cello note swelling. No text overlays, no black frames.
